model_annotation: The figure presents two line graphs, each plotting ILEU values against a different variable. The left graph displays ILEU as a function of α, with the x-axis ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 in increments of 0.2, and the y-axis ranging from 28.0 to 28.5 in increments of 0.1. The data is represented by a solid blue line connecting circular markers, showing an initial increase in ILEU from 28.0 at α = 0.1 to a peak of 28.3 at α = 0.9, followed by a sharp decrease to 28.0 at α = 1.0. The right graph plots ILEU against P, with the x-axis ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 in increments of 0.1, and the y-axis scaled identically to the left graph. This graph also uses a solid blue line with circular markers, depicting an increase in ILEU from 28.3 at P = 0.05 to a peak of 28.4 at P = 0.35, followed by a decrease to 28.0 at P = 0.45.
